cohort: 120 twin births at Darbhanga Medical and Hospital, Obstetrics and Gynecology Department, Laheriasarai, Bihar, India, from November 2021 to October 2022
finding: Twin pregnancies were associated with a high rate of preterm labor (75%), anemia (60%), low birth weight (85%), and perinatal mortality (15%).
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the most common mode of delivery (76.6%).
